description_zh: 调用DeleteDISyncTask接口，删除数据集成同步任务。当前仅支持使用该接口删除实时数据同步任务
name: DeleteDISyncTask

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to obtain the workspace ID.

You must configure this parameter to specify the DataWorks workspace to which the operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。

该参数用于确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the task. Set the value to DI_REALTIME, which indicates a real-time synchronization task
parameters.help_zh:
数据集成同步任务的类型。
当前仅支持取值为DI_REALTIME，表示实时数据同步任务
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the real-time synchronization task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 实时数据同步任务的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html接口获取任务ID
parameters.name: file_id

Data.description_zh: 删除数据集成同步任务的结果

Message.description_en: The reason why the synchronization task fails to be deleted. If the synchronization task is deleted, the value null is returned for this parameter
Message.description_zh:
删除数据集成同步任务失败后的原因描述。
如果删除数据集成同步任务成功，则该参数的返回值为空

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the synchronization task is deleted. Valid values:

success: The synchronization task is deleted.

fail: The synchronization task fails to be deleted. You can troubleshoot the issue based on the failure reason
Status.description_zh:
删除数据集成同步任务的结果状态。取值如下：
success：表示删除数据集成同步任务成功。
fail：表示删除数据集成同步任务失败。您可以查看具体的失败原因处理问题

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can locate logs and troubleshoot issues based on the ID
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
